author: Axiom I
title: Nova Self-Metrics Adapter v0.1: JSON → rolling CSV (W=5)
abstract: Reads Nova’s metric_sample.json and emits self_metrics_v0_1_per_lineage_rolling.csv (W=5). Tolerant parser (metric/value or novelty/convergence/diversity keys).

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json
IN_PATH = "storage/nova/metric_sample.json"
OUT_DIR = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv"

def main():
    sys.path.append("storage/shared")
    from agency_lab.adapters.nova_self_metrics_adapter_v0_1 import run_on_file
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    summary = run_on_file(IN_PATH, OUT_DIR, default_lineage="nova", W=5)
    print("SUMMARY", json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    for k, v in summary["outputs"].items():
        print("WROTE", k, v)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
        raise SystemExit(1)
